c74object.name: evi_biquads_union
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_biquads_union.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_biquads_union.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_biquads_union.genexpr file also requires:
evi_biquads_coeffs.genexpr
About this File:
Higher level filter type selectors for all 40 filter coefficient calculators included in 'evi_biquads_coeffs.genexpr'. Use this file to easily test all the different Biquad types in evieve.

entry.name: eviBiquadCoeff ( )
entry.description:
Global selector for all 40 filter types, @see: [evi.biquad.filter~], [evi.biquadcoeff~] and [evi.biquadcoeff] for example wrappers and index listing
In 1: type=input: filter, (int) filter index (type), see abstractions or source code for listing
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: gain, Gain (linear)
In 4: type=input: fullQ, Q
Return 1: a0, a0 coefficient
Return 2: a1, a1 coefficient
Return 3: a2, a2 coefficient
Return 4: b1, b1 coefficient
Return 5: b2, b2 coefficient
